Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v7
Run actions/setup-python@v7
Run pip install -r requirements.txt
Regression tests (repository fixtures, before any cache restore)
Restore last successfully verified public snapshot
Restore last successfully verified TWC source snapshot
Preserve last-good snapshot pair for in-run fallback
Refresh all Hotspawn CS2 records and supported external lines
Research only unresolved fixture picks using first-party lines
Document why every blank pick stayed blank (leads only, never prices)
Record which line sources actually answered this refresh (read-only, non-fatal)
Refresh dated TWC Day-3 results, Day-4 and Day-5 research (no pricing override)
Order platform publishers and record Pages configuration
Reconcile every row, replay every probability and build linked pages
Inspect source freshness for cache eligibility
Preserve verified evidence for a future source outage
Preserve verified TWC originals and line-movement history
Run actions/configure-pages@v6
Run actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
Run actions/deploy-pages@v5
Verify the public site, its complete data and category pages
Re-read the public snapshot after the legacy-publisher window
Republish the verified artifact if a legacy build overwrote it
Verify the republished site
Publish the verified build into the branch root (the legacy Pages source)
Wait for the root-sync commit's legacy Pages build
Re-deploy the verified artifact over the legacy root build
Verify the public site after root-sync re-deploy
Post Run actions/setup-python@v7
Post Run actions/checkout@v7
Complete job
